config.description: The Salt agent's API key. Shown once when the agent is created.

config.description: The Salt agent's id (a UUID). Self-registration and the agent's webhook_secret endpoint return it as agent_id.

config.description: The Salt agent's armored PGP public key.

config.label: The Salt agent's armored PGP private key
config.description: The Salt agent's armored PGP private key. Never leaves this machine.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Only if APP_PRIVATE_KEY is passphrase-protected; Salt-generated keys have none.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Id of this server's configured front-door agent.

config.label: OAuth 2
config.description: OAuth 2.1 bearer token ("Bearer sat_..."), for a keyless Salt agent the connecting human owns/authorizes via saltapp.ai's OAuth flow. This is now the RECOMMENDED way to connect -- no header is required up front; an MCP client that supports OAuth discovers the flow automatically from this endpoint's 401 response (RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp, naming https://saltapp.ai as the authorization server). See README.md's "Hosted server" section.

config.label: LEGACY: a pre-existing Salt agent's own API key, for the small api-key-only tool set (list_salt_agents, list_products, create_product)
config.description: LEGACY: a pre-existing Salt agent's own API key, for the small api-key-only tool set (list_salt_agents, list_products, create_product). Sent per-request; never stored by the hosted server. Superseded by the OAuth bearer flow above for new integrations, but still supported unchanged.

config.label: LEGACY: paired with X-Salt-Api-Key above; the agent's numeric/user id, sent verbatim
config.description: LEGACY: paired with X-Salt-Api-Key above; the agent's numeric/user id, sent verbatim.
